parts.role: U1 MCU, TSSOP-20, Cortex-M0, internal 8MHz HSI (no crystal), single 3.3V rail. RULED at P1; re-verified live 2026-08-16 (stock 18977, was 19015 at P1 - normal drift, still >>25 floor). SWD on PA13/PA14 comes up live at reset with internal pulls (mcu-swd-port-live-at-reset-stm32f0) - zero external SWD parts. BOOT0(1) has no internal pull and needs R1 (mcu-boot-select-strap-stm32f0). Alternate C32908 = STM32F030F4P6 (no TR suffix, tube-packed instead of tape-and-reel): identical die/pinout, same LCSC datasheet doc ID 2304140030 as C89040's own PDF - the closest thing to a true pin-compatible drop-in this catalog offers, stock 1329 (>>25). PY32F030F28P6TU is NOT listed as an alternate: rejected at P1 on a hard ground (vendor domain not on the research fetch allowlist, never a verified drop-in) per the spawn prompt's explicit instruction. STM32C011F4P6/STM32G031F4P6 from research/mcu.json were also not used as alternates - both share the TSSOP-20 package but move BOOT0 and NRST to different physical pins (BOOT0 rides PA14, NRST is PF2), so populating either in this footprint would need different net connections, not a drop-in swap.

C1 VDD(16)/VSS(15) HF decoupler - DS Fig 12 caption 'must be decoupled', one HF cap per supply pin pair since TSSOP-20 bonds exactly one digital pair (mcu-supply-pin-pair-decoupling). Place at the pin, own ground via (mcu-decoupler-is-the-local-source). Basic, --pick basic-passive, 50V rail (>>16V preference).

C2 VDD bulk reservoir (AN4325 'C6, used for VDD'), DS Fig 12 REQUIRED. --pick basic-passive returned no_candidate at 4.7uF/0402-0603-0805 (verified against the raw window: every 4.7uF X7R hit up to 1206 is JLC Extended in this catalog snapshot - a genuine gap in the curated Basic list, not a bad query). Hand-picked: 0603 (per assignment), 16V (meets the >=16V preference - at 3.3V that is a 20.6% V/Vrated ratio, so X7R DC-bias derating stays modest; noted as an observation, not a functional risk at this board's <100mA budget, per the assignment's own framing). Stock 32035, far above the 25-unit floor and higher again for this Extended part.

C3 VDDA(5) HF decoupler (AN4325 C3), returns to shared VSS - TSSOP-20 has no VSSA pin (mcu-analog-rail-tracks-digital-rail). DS Fig 12 REQUIRED. --pick basic-passive returned no_candidate at 10nF/0603 (same Basic-catalog gap as C2). Hand-picked: 0603, 25V (exceeds the 16V preference, and was cheaper than the 16V-rated 0603 option found - both stocked in the hundreds of thousands), YAGEO with a fetchable datasheet.

C4 VDDA(5) bulk (AN4325 C5), returns to shared VSS - same package fact as C3. DS Fig 12 REQUIRED. --pick basic-passive returned no_candidate at 1uF/0603 (same Basic-catalog gap). Hand-picked: 0603, 16V meets the preference, X7R dielectric (not X5R) - DC-bias derating at the 3.3V rail / 16V rating is modest and stated here as an observation per the assignment, not a functional concern at this board's <100mA budget. Cheapest qualifying 0603 option at or above 16V; stock 647811.

R1 BOOT0(1) pull-down to GND - BOOT0 has NO internal pull, unlike NRST (mcu-boot-select-strap-stm32f0, mcu-reset-sampled-pin-audit); datasheet-REQUIRED support for repeatable boot-from-flash per requirements.md s2 point 5. Basic, --pick basic-passive, stock 8.07M. Note: this listing's min_qty (1195) is LCSC's own storefront reel minimum, an informational field parts_search passes through unfiltered - it does not gate JLCPCB PCBA's assembly feed, which draws the 5 pieces this build needs from stock rather than requiring a buyer-side reel purchase.

J1 power input, silk +/- is the ONLY reverse-polarity defence on this board (no protection by mode). Through-hole CONFIRMED from the part's own mechanical drawing (pins protrude below the housing base through round PCB holes; drawing titled 'PCB SCREW TERMINAL BLOCK', PCB LAYOUT view shows round through-holes at 5.08mm pitch) - not inferred from the package/type text fields, per the connector warning. 250V/18A rating is far oversized for 3.3V/<0.1A, which is normal for this connector class; picked for stock margin (275684, by far the largest of the through-hole screw-terminal candidates found) and a real fetchable datasheet.

ONE entry for TWO distinct refdes, per the 'one entry per DISTINCT part' rule - qty_per_board=2. J2 (SWD debug header: GND/SWCLK/3V3/SWDIO/NRST, positions 1-5, RULED at P1) and J3 (GPIO header: IO1/IO2/GND/IO3/IO4 = PA0-PA3+GND) are the SAME physical 1x5 0.1in straight male header. Through-hole CONFIRMED from the part's own mechanical drawing (pins protrude below the housing through round PCB holes per its 'RECOMMEND P.C.B LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)' view, 1.02mm dia holes at 2.54mm pitch) - not inferred from package/type text, per the connector warning. Straight/vertical variant (ZZ suffix, matching the catalog's right-angle 'WZ' sibling naming) since both headers sit on board edges with pins facing off-board flat, per placement.edges rot convention. Stock 41368 clears 5x the total instances needed (2/board x 5 boards = 10; floor 50) by a wide margin. Zero external components on either header per constraints.json notes (SWD needs none - internal pulls live at reset; GPIO is plain digital I/O).

H1-H4 mounting clearance holes (e.g. KiCad MountingHole:MountingHole_3.2mm_M3), footprint-only - NOT an orderable LCSC part. No LCSC code exists for a hole and none is invented here: 'no LCSC number' is not 'cannot be bought', and conflating the two would falsely block release at P9 (a prior run's recorded trap). Count is 4 (requirements.md s5 default: inset from the corners with washer keepouts) but is explicitly NOT settled here - the outline does not exist yet on this board (geometry is an OUTPUT, earned at P6), and requirements.md s5 / blocks.md s6 both defer the 4-vs-2 call to P6, sanctioning two on opposite corners if the earned outline is too small to hold four with washer clearance. This entry stands for whichever count P6 lands on.
